items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Not Lloyd Armstrong. [INTERVIEWER] Yes, Bill Armstrong. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, yeah.

ctx.x: Yes, Bill Armstrong. Yes, he came in here with Bill George's. He wanted to buy a little George's, but somebody, he hadn't heard about it. See, he had a gold trumpet.
